newsitem.title: UK: Carlton gains as Morgan Stanley upgrades.
newsitem.headline: Carlton gains as Morgan Stanley upgrades.

text.p: Shares in Carlton Communications Plc were among the biggest gainers in the FTSE 100 index at midday on Wednesday as analysts at Morgan Stanley upgraded their stance on the stock, dealers said.

The investment bank raised Carlton to "strong buy" from "outperform," saying the media business remained a growth area, Carlton's management had a good track record and the stock looked cheap, market sources said.
Analysts at the brokerage were not immediately available for comment. Carlton shares were up 11p or 2.2 percent at 509-1/2 by 1141 GMT in volume of just under one million shares.

Dealers said Carlton was due a rebound after recent declines. It touched a four-month low of 487p on April 14. "It has been a dreadful market so it's not surprising to see it bounce," said one market-maker in the stock.
